scope.routePolicy: One manifest-ordered sequential main route per Celeste Side or Ori area. Optional and inferred side exits are outside this run.

method.input: Progress-sensitive Cablester movement input holds right and only jumps or dashes after a stall, wall contact, fall or liquid contact.
method.simulation: The real Game fixed-step update, collision, damage/death reset, room state reset and asynchronous room-exit loader are used.

statusPolicy.reason: This proves an automated main-route traversal through every collection on the fingerprinted build. It does not prove every side exit, human feel, original-coordinate fidelity, art fidelity or room-by-room manual browser acceptance.
